examples.japanese: {種々|しゅじゅ}の{問題|もんだい}がある。
{種々|しゅじゅ}の{意見|いけん}が{出|で}た。
{種々|しゅじゅ}{様々|さまざま}な{商品|しょうひん}が{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: A wide variety of products are displayed.

notes:
READING NOTE:
Also written and read as {種々|くさぐさ} in more literary contexts.

USAGE:
{種々|しゅじゅ} is more formal and literary than {色々|いろいろ} (various). Often used in written or formal contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- {種々|しゅじゅ}{様々|さまざま} - all sorts of; various and sundry
- {種々|しゅじゅ}{雑多|ざった} - miscellaneous; sundry

SYNONYMS:
- {色々|いろいろ} - various (more common, less formal)
- {様々|さまざま} - various, diverse
- {諸々|もろもろ} - various, all sorts of (formal)
